definitions: An individual who possesses or utilizes skills and knowledge across multiple distinct capabilities or domains.
A person who can effectively operate or contribute in various functional areas or with different sets of tools/technologies.
examples: The project team needed a cross-capability user to bridge the gap between design and development.
Her role as a cross-capability user made her invaluable during the system integration phase.
Identifying cross-capability users is key for agile team formation.
